## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short single-fascicle Yuán Vinaya pedagogy manual for newly-ordained *bhikṣus* (*bìchú* 苾芻 — Yuán-Tibetan transliteration for the Skt. *bhikṣu*, replacing the older Chinese *bǐqiū* 比丘) according to the **Mūlasarvāstivāda** 根本說一切有部 by **ʼPhags-pa** 拔合思巴 ([拔合思巴](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%8B%94%E5%90%88%E6%80%9D%E5%B7%B4), 1235–1280). Author signature: *元帝師苾芻拔合思巴集* (*Compiled by Imperial Preceptor and Bhikṣu ʼPhags-pa of the Yuán*).

**Abstract**

The *Xíxué lüèfǎ* is the pedagogical companion to ʼPhags-pa's [KR6k0191](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0191) *Yífàn* (the karman-formulary for ordination). Together they constitute the practical introduction of the **Tibetan-Buddhist Mūlasarvāstivāda** Vinaya tradition into Mongol-imperial Buddhist practice. The text follows the *gradual training* schema of the Tibetan *Sa-skya* lineage's instructional literature on the *prātimokṣa*-vow. Use of the transliteration *bìchú* 苾芻 (rather than the Chinese standard *bǐqiū* 比丘) is itself a marker of the *Mūlasarvāstivāda* lineage and persists thereafter in Tibetan-Buddhist Chinese-language texts.
